notes.title: May The 4th Be With You Sale!
notes.content:
Celebrate May the 4th with savings on LEGO(c) Star Wars (TM): The Skywalker Saga and LEGO(c) Star Wars (TM): The Force Awakens!


Get immersed in the entire Star Wars saga as you go on a legendary journey in a galaxy far, far away in LEGO(c) Star Wars (TM): The Skywalker Saga.
[previewyoutube=n49TsZAwFEs;full][/previewyoutube]

Relive the epic action from the blockbuster film with exclusive playable content that takes you on adventures between Star Wars (TM): Return of the Jedi and Star Wars (TM): The Force Awakens.
[previewyoutube=5584iglGRWE;full][/previewyoutube]
